name: branch-dependency-trace
theory_gate_citation: Complementary to docs/STATUS.md B1. The closed routes in docs/theory/README.md §4 concern compressing completed histories; this measures whether most intermediate work can be SKIPPED, which none of them address.
notes: All preprocessing is charged to the algorithm: there is no precomputed table. The short-circuit is an exact algebraic cancellation (D_d(t) sits inside the OR), and the traced value is checked bit-exactly against a direct simulation at every reported depth.
